system.description:
You enhance your heads metabolism and manipulate the hair that grows longer as a result creating shredding whips of hair that act like threaded garrote wire. Select one creature you can see within range and make a melee ninjutsu attack, dealing 6d10 slashing damage as it tears into them, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Bleed and are pulled up to 30-feet closer. On a success, no further effects.

Shin-Seal: If an affected creature has a Shin Seal, you can dispel it. If you do your hair becomes saturated in your bio-oil, coating them in 2 ranks of Doused.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d10 and the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, if the target creatures size is large or larger, the attack is made at advantage, and you roll the damage twice, taking the higher result.
